items.name: Windows telemetry
items.summary: Collects diagnostic and usage data about this PC and sends it to Microsoft.
items.effect: Microsoft receives less data about how this PC is used. Nothing you use stops working, though Feedback Hub and Windows Insider builds may not be able to report problems.

items.name: Error reporting
items.summary: Offers to send details to Microsoft when an app crashes or stops responding.
items.effect: Windows stops offering to send crash details after an app fails. Apps still close and restart as before.

items.name: App compatibility telemetry
items.summary: Scans the programs installed on this PC and reports compatibility information to Microsoft.
items.effect: Windows stops scanning your programs for compatibility data. Updating Windows still works; Microsoft just gets less warning about apps that may not suit a new version.

items.name: Customer Experience Improvement Program
items.summary: Gathers usage statistics for Microsoft's improvement program, if you joined it.
items.effect: Usage statistics are no longer gathered. If you never joined the program, these tasks already do nothing.

items.name: Disk health reporting
items.summary: Sends general disk and system information to Microsoft for the improvement program.
items.effect: Disk information is no longer sent to Microsoft. Your drives are not affected.

items.name: Feedback requests
items.summary: Prepares the feedback questions and surveys Windows sometimes shows.
items.effect: Windows stops asking for feedback. The Feedback Hub app still works when you open it yourself.

items.name: App list for Windows Backup
items.summary: Makes a list of your installed desktop apps so Windows Backup can offer them on a new PC.
items.effect: Windows Backup may not know which desktop apps to suggest when you set up another PC.

items.name: Office telemetry
items.summary: Collects Office usage and error data for Microsoft's telemetry dashboard, mostly used by IT teams.
items.effect: Office stops gathering that data. Office itself works the same.

items.name: Recall snapshots
items.summary: Recall can save snapshots of your screen every few seconds so you can search what you saw. It stays off unless you turn it on in Settings, and it only exists on Copilot+ PCs.
items.effect: Switches on the Windows setting “Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall”. Recall can no longer save snapshots, and Windows deletes any it saved before.

items.name: Click to Do
items.summary: Takes a screenshot when you use it and analyzes it on your PC to suggest actions. It does nothing until you open it.
items.effect: Click to Do is no longer available. Nothing else changes.

items.name: Windows AI components
items.summary: Hosts the AI components built into Windows so apps can use them on your PC.
items.effect: AI features in Windows apps may not work until you turn this back on. It stays available, so Windows can still start it for anything that asks.

items.name: Xbox services
items.summary: Xbox sign-in, cloud game saves, networking and accessory support.
items.effect: Xbox app and Game Pass games, Microsoft Store games and Xbox accessories may stop signing in or saving to the cloud. Games from other stores are not affected.

items.name: Phone Link and nearby devices
items.summary: Connects this PC with your phone and nearby devices.
items.effect: Phone Link, Nearby Sharing and casting to a wireless display may stop working until you turn this back on.

items.name: Location
items.summary: Works out where this PC is for apps and Windows features.
items.effect: Weather, maps, Find My Device and automatic time zone can't find your location until you turn this back on.

items.name: Offline maps
items.summary: Keeps maps you downloaded for offline use up to date.
items.effect: Downloaded offline maps are no longer updated by themselves. Online maps are not affected.

items.name: Wallet and NFC payments
items.summary: Supports tap-to-pay and other NFC features that use a secure chip.
items.effect: Tap-to-pay and NFC features that use a secure chip stop working. Most PCs don't have this hardware.

items.name: Retail demo mode
items.summary: Runs the demo mode used on display PCs in shops.
items.effect: Nothing changes on a normal PC.

items.name: Mobile hotspot and connection sharing
items.summary: Lets this PC share its internet connection with other devices.
items.effect: Mobile hotspot and internet connection sharing stop working until you turn this back on.

items.name: Media sharing
items.summary: Shares your music, pictures and videos with TVs and other devices on your network.
items.effect: Your media library is no longer shared with other devices on your network.

items.name: Superfetch (SysMain)
items.summary: Learns which apps you use and loads them into memory ahead of time.
items.effect: Apps may take a little longer to open, mostly on older hard drives. On a PC with an SSD you may not notice any difference.

items.name: Startup app reminders
items.summary: Shows a notice when you have a lot of startup apps.
items.effect: Windows stops reminding you about startup apps. The Startup page in TidyWindow still lists them.

items.name: Widgets
items.summary: The Widgets board and the background programs it uses (WidgetService and WidgetBoard).
items.effect: Hides the Widgets button and board and stops its background programs after you sign in again. It also removes the weather on the lock screen.
